name: Raycasting Phase
aliases: Two-Pass Raycasting with Back-Face Depth Buffering
definition: The final raycasting time is determined by the runtime of the thread that takes the most integration steps, which depends on the view and decomposition geometry interaction.
summary: Raycasting Phase samples volumetric data along camera rays to compute optical properties using a two-pass rasterization strategy that determines ray entry and exit points via back-face depth buffering.
